name: TimeSlotTape
job: Offer appointment or class times on a tape-measure strip the visitor flicks; the time under the centre mark enlarges and fills the booking button label
visitor_action: drag or swipe the tape; arrow keys step by slot; tap a slot to snap; press the button to follow the booking link
mobile: full-width tape with large touch targets, haptic-style snap
motion: tape glides with inertia and snaps with a tiny overshoot, centre slot scales up (reduced-motion: slots highlight without gliding)
studio2_tested: editor bug: canvas "Something went wrong", add-panel preview OK (2026-11-23)
art_direction: Night dial: graphite-black ground, cool grey ticks, tabular sans numerals; selected slot lit mint under a frosted centre lens (the only material)
